title: jmap-did: which properties are DID-bearing
description: draft-atwood-jmap-did-00.md :205 says a property naming someone other than the owning account is not DID-bearing, but examples contradict it: ContactCard did (:264), Participant did (:260), receiving-side Message senderDid (:272), VTCParticipant did (:278). Narrow :205 or reword the examples.
